name: order_id
description: Unique business identifier for the sales order

name: customer_email
description: Cleansed and validated RFC-compliant customer email address

name: amount
description: Valid sales amount strictly greater than zero

name: order_date
description: Date of the order transaction, used as partition key

name: etl_loaded_at
description: Timestamp in UTC when record was ingested by the ETL pipeline

name: etl_job_id
description: Correlation ID of the ETL batch execution
